Container.Name: PlexMind
Container.Overview:
AI-powered Plex recommendations using a fully local llama.cpp LLM. Analyzes each user's watch history and generates personalized movie/TV picks with no cloud, no API costs, and no data leaving your server.
Also includes: Whisper ASR subtitle generation, llama.cpp-powered subtitle translation, and library maintenance tools.
Needs a llama.cpp container with a GGUF model, and a Whisper ASR container for transcription.
Open http://[IP]:[PORT:8000]/ and sign in with Plex: no token to copy, no API key to make.
Container.Description: PlexMind in one container. Version line: v1.0.0. Runs the dashboard/API, the recommendation worker, the subtitle scripts and a narrow Docker broker. It mounts your media read-write and the Docker socket (used only to start and stop the Whisper and llama.cpp containers), so do not expose port 8000 to the internet. After install, open the dashboard and sign in with the Plex account that owns your server.

Variable.Name: LLAMA_CPP_URL
Variable.Description: Your llama.cpp container, by LAN IP and host port (not localhost).

Variable.Name: WHISPER_API_URL
Variable.Description: Your Whisper ASR container's /asr address, by LAN IP and host port.

Variable.Name: LLAMA_CPP_MODEL_ALIAS
Variable.Description: First model to use: a GGUF file name in your models folder, without .gguf. Switch any time in the dashboard. Get one that fits your GPU with: setup.sh --model /mnt/user/appdata/llama-cpp/models

Variable.Name: TARGET_LANGUAGES
Variable.Description: Languages to translate subtitles into, comma-separated (e.g. zh,es-MX,fr)

Variable.Name: TMDB_API_KEY
Variable.Description: Optional: ratings and posters for recommendations. Free at themoviedb.org/settings/api

Variable.Name: LLAMA_ON_DEMAND
Variable.Description: 1: start llama.cpp only when needed and stop it when idle, to free the GPU. 0: leave it running.

Variable.Name: WHISPER_MODEL
Variable.Description: Whisper model your Whisper container uses (turbo, medium, small, base)

Variable.Name: WHISPER_CONTAINER_NAME
Variable.Description: Name of your Whisper container; PlexMind starts and stops only this one and llama.cpp
